chunks: Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl ibn Bazīʿ asked al-Riḍā عليه السلام about a woman who made her bondwoman lawful for her husband.
So he said: “That is for him.”
He said: “Then what if he fears that she may be joking?”
He said: “If he knows that she is joking, then no.”

key_terms.أَحَلَّتْ: made lawful or permitted in this legal context
key_terms.تَمْزَحُ: she is joking or not speaking seriously

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible if a wife allows her husband access to her bondwoman, and what if she was only joking?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a woman permitting her husband access to her bondwoman. Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام states that it is valid when truly intended, but not if it is known to have been said in jest.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4575 - Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Bazi asked Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as) about a woman who permitted her husband to have relations with her bondwoman.
Imam (as) said: "That is permissible for him."
He then asked: "What if he fears that she might be joking?"
Imam (as) said: "If he knows that she is joking, then it is not permissible."
